brief: Why you should aim to be disliked by 50% of your audience.

slots.title: WHY HALF YOUR AUDIENCE SHOULD HATE YOU
PLEASING EVERYONE FAILS
slots.body: When you try to appeal to everyone, you dilute your message into beige noise. Strong brands require sharp edges that not everyone can handle. Neutrality is the enemy of memorability.

slots.title: POLARIZATION BUILDS LOYALTY
slots.body: The people who love you will fight for you when you stand for something specific. Fifty percent repulsion creates fifty percent devotion that lasts.

slots.title: WEAK OPINIONS HURT YOU
slots.body: Sitting on the fence positions you as replaceable and forgettable. The market does not reward timid voices or lukewarm takes. It rewards courage.

slots.title: FILTERS FIND YOUR TRIBE
slots.body: When you repel the wrong people, you magnetize the right ones. Dislike is a feature, not a bug, for building a true community.

slots.title: SAFE BRANDS ARE INVISIBLE
slots.body: The most successful creators and companies have loud detractors. If nobody disagrees with you, your voice is too quiet to matter.

slots.title: START WITH YOUR TRUTH
slots.body: State your real beliefs without apology. The audience that stays will be more engaged, profitable, and aligned than a passive crowd ever could.

slots.headline: BE BRAVE ENOUGH TO BE HATED
slots.body: Pick a fight worth having today. Your real audience is waiting on the other side.
